advisories.title: Deserialization of Untrusted Data in org.codehaus.jackson:jackson-mapper-asl
advisories.description: Affected versions of org.codehaus.jackson:jackson-mapper-asl are vulnerable to Deserialization of Untrusted Data. A flaw in jackson-mapper-asl allows untrusted JSON to be deserialized into arbitrary Java types via ObjectMapper data-binding APIs, so attacker-controlled input can trigger unsafe object instantiation during deserialization, enabling critical impact when such input reaches these code paths.Note:This repository is archived.

owaspIds: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures
